                    ;
END

procedures.name: syncHubMo
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    START TRANSACTION;

    -- 1. Update fun_hub_queue with data from master_raw_orders
    UPDATE fun_hub_queue fhq
    JOIN master_raw_orders mro
      ON (
        (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility') AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           IF(fhq.mobile_number IS NULL OR fhq.mobile_number = '', '0000000000', fhq.mobile_number),
           NULLIF(fhq.product_type, '')
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id
        )
        OR
        (NOT (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility')) AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           NULLIF(fhq.product_type, '')
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id
        )
        OR
        (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility') AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           IF(fhq.mobile_number IS NULL OR fhq.mobile_number = '', '0000000000', fhq.mobile_number)
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2
        )
        OR
        (NOT (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility')) AND
         NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, '') = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2
        )
      )
    SET
      fhq.sync_status = 'Matching'
    WHERE fhq.sync_status = 'Pending';

    -- 2. Update master_raw_orders with data from fun_hub_queue
    UPDATE master_raw_orders mro
    JOIN fun_hub_queue fhq
      ON (
        (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility') AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           IF(fhq.mobile_number IS NULL OR fhq.mobile_number = '', '0000000000', fhq.mobile_number),
           NULLIF(fhq.product_type, '')
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id
        )
        OR
        (NOT (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility')) AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           NULLIF(fhq.product_type, '')
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id
        )
        OR
        (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility') AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           IF(fhq.mobile_number IS NULL OR fhq.mobile_number = '', '0000000000', fhq.mobile_number)
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2
        )
        OR
        (NOT (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility')) AND
         NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, '') = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2
        )
      )
    SET
      mro.employee_id = fhq.employee_id,
      mro.hub_fun_id = fhq.fun_id
    WHERE fhq.sync_status = 'Matching';

    -- 3. Mark matched rows as complete
    UPDATE fun_hub_queue
    SET sync_status = 'Matched'
    WHERE sync_status = 'Matching';

    COMMIT;
END

procedures.name: updateAirtableRefIds
updateReconciliationIdsByTable
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    SET @sql = CONCAT(
        'UPDATE ', table_name, ' mp ',
        'LEFT JOIN commissions.overwrite_values ov ON mp.db_id = ov.', id_name, ' ',
        'LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_logins l ',
        '   ON l.username = mp.ref_login_username_id ',
        '   AND l.system_column = mp.carrier_system ',
        'LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history sh ',
        '   ON sh.employee_id = COALESCE(l.employee_id, mp.employee_id) ',
        '   AND mp.order_date BETWEEN sh.start_date AND sh.end_date ',
        'LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team t ',
        '   ON sh.team_id = t.team_id ',
        'LEFT JOIN airtable.align_product_classification_current pc ',
        '   ON (CASE WHEN t.business_unit = 'd2d' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) = pc.program_id ',
        '   AND mp.package_name = pc.package_name ',
        '   AND (CASE ',
        '           WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv','dsi') THEN 'saraplus' ',
        '           WHEN mp.carrier_system LIKE 'lumos' THEN 'POPS' ',
        '           ELSE mp.carrier_system ',
        '       END) = pc.system_type ',
        '   AND pc.purchase_type = (CASE ',
        '           WHEN mp.purchase_type IS NULL OR mp.purchase_type = '' THEN 'NEW' ',
        '           ELSE UPPER(mp.purchase_type) ',
        '       END) ',
        'SET ',
        '   mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id = CASE ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')), ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, '0000000000'), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, '0000000000')), ',
        '           NULLIF(mp.product_type, '') ',
        '       ) ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN CONCAT(',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')), ',
        '           NULLIF(mp.product_type, '') ',
        '       ) ',
        '       ELSE CONCAT(',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')), ',
        '           NULLIF(mp.product_type, '') ',
        '       ) ',
        '   END, ',
        '   mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 = CASE ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')), ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, '0000000000'), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, '0000000000')) ',
        '       ) ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')) ',
        '       ELSE ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')) ',
        '   END, ',
        '   mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 = CASE ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')) ',
        '       ELSE ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')) ',
        '   END, ',
        '   mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 = NULLIF(mp.customer_name, ''), ',
        '   mp.mo_general_ref_id = CASE ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')) ',
        '       ELSE ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')) ',
        '   END ',
        'WHERE ',
        '   mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id IS NULL ',
        '   OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 IS NULL ',
        '   OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 IS NULL ',
        '   OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 IS NULL ',
        '   OR mp.mo_general_ref_id IS NULL'
    );

    PREPARE stmt FROM @sql;
    EXECUTE stmt;
    DEALLOCATE PREPARE stmt;
END

procedures.name: updateReconciliationIdsMa
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    UPDATE master_raw_addons mp
    LEFT JOIN commissions.overwrite_values ov
        ON mp.db_id = ov.ma_db_id
    
    SET
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, '')),
                'addon'
            )
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                'addon'
            )
            ELSE CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')),
                'addon'
            )
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, ''))
            )
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
        END,
        -- mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 = NULLIF(mp.customer_name, ''),
        mp.mo_general_ref_id = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
        END
    WHERE mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 IS NULL
       -- OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_general_ref_id IS NULL;
END

procedures.name: updateReconciliationIdsMro
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    UPDATE master_raw_orders mp
    LEFT JOIN commissions.overwrite_values ov
        ON mp.db_id = ov.mo_db_id 
LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_logins l
	on l.username = mp.ref_login_username_id and 
    l.system_column = mp.carrier_system
        
    LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history sh
		on sh.employee_id = coalesce(l.employee_id,mp.employee_id)
		and mp.order_date between sh.start_date and sh.end_date
	LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team t
		on sh.team_id = t.team_id
	LEFT JOIN airtable.align_product_classification_current pc
		ON case when t.business_unit = 'd2d' then 1 else 2 end = pc.program_id
		AND mp.package_name = pc.package_name
		AND case when mp.carrier_system in ('dtv','dsi') then 'saraplus' when mp.carrier_system like 'lumos' then 'POPS' else mp.carrier_system end = pc.system_type
		AND pc.purchase_type = CASE
			WHEN mp.purchase_type IS NULL OR mp.purchase_type  = '' THEN 'NEW'
			ELSE UPPER(mp.purchase_type) 
		end
    SET
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, '')),
                NULLIF(pc.product_type, '')
            )
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                NULLIF(pc.product_type, '')
            )
            ELSE CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')),
                NULLIF(pc.product_type, '')
            )
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, ''))
            )
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 = NULLIF(mp.customer_name, ''),
        mp.mo_general_ref_id = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
        END
    WHERE 
    
		mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_general_ref_id IS NULL
       and mp.status != 'abandoned'
       and pc.package_name is not null
       ;
END

procedures.name: alignMaRefIds
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    -- -----------------------------
    -- Update master_raw_orders table
    -- -----------------------------
    UPDATE master_activity ma
    JOIN (
        WITH RECURSIVE upline_ma AS (
            SELECT
                a.m_id as db_id,
                a.activity_date,
                e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id,
                t.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id,
                t.team_id_upline,
                e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id_level,
                t.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id_level,
                l.team_level
            FROM master_activity a
            LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e 
                ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id 
               AND a.activity_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
                   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
            LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
                ON t.team_id = e.team_id 
               AND a.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
                   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
            LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l
                ON l.team_id = t.team_id
            WHERE a.db_change_date > date_sub(now(),INTERval 2 day) and
				(a.upline_ref_id IS NULL
               OR a.seller_ref_id IS NULL
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_1 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_1 IS NOT NULL)
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_2 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_2 IS NOT NULL)
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_3 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_3 IS NOT NULL)
               )

            UNION ALL

            SELECT 
                child.db_id,
                child.activity_date,
                child.seller_history_ref_id,
                child.upline_history_ref_id,
                t.team_id_upline,
                e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id_level,
                t.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id_level,
                l.team_level
            FROM upline_ma child
            JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
                ON t.team_id = child.team_id_upline 
               AND child.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
                   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
            LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e
                ON e.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
               AND child.activity_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
                   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
            JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
                ON l.team_id = child.team_id_upline
        )
        SELECT 
            ro.db_id,
            MAX(ro.seller_history_ref_id) AS seller_ref_id,
            MAX(ro.upline_history_ref_id) AS upline_ref_id,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 6 THEN ro.seller_history_ref_id_level END) AS seller_ref_id_level_6,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 6 THEN ro.upline_history_ref_id_level END) AS upline_ref_id_level_6,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 5 THEN ro.seller_history_ref_id_level END) AS seller_ref_id_level_5,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 5 THEN ro.upline_history_ref_id_level END) AS upline_ref_id_level_5,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 4 THEN ro.seller_history_ref_id_level END) AS seller_ref_id_level_4,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 4 THEN ro.upline_history_ref_id_level END) AS upline_ref_id_level_4
        FROM upline_ma ro
        GROUP BY ro.db_id
    ) agg
    ON ma.m_id = agg.db_id
    SET 
        ma.seller_ref_id = agg.seller_ref_id,
        ma.upline_ref_id = agg.upline_ref_id,
        ma.seller_ref_id_level_1 = agg.seller_ref_id_level_6,
        ma.upline_ref_id_level_1 = agg.upline_ref_id_level_6,
        ma.seller_ref_id_level_2 = agg.seller_ref_id_level_5,
        ma.upline_ref_id_level_2 = agg.upline_ref_id_level_5,
        ma.seller_ref_id_level_3 = agg.seller_ref_id_level_4,
        ma.upline_ref_id_level_3 = agg.upline_ref_id_level_4
;

    
END

procedures.name: GenerateActivityPropertyDay
procedures.contentString:
begin
delete from reports.ag_mdu_activity_property_day where activity_date between range_one and range_two;

insert into reports.ag_mdu_activity_property_day(
	company_id,activity_date,
    property_name,
    property_tier,
    property_origin,
    property_status,
    calls,
    meetings,
    other_engagement,
    result_complete,
    result_connected,
    activity_blitz,
    activity_lunch_learn,
    activity_marketing,
    owner_id
    )
    
	
	
SELECT 
    IFNULL(comp.hub_id, 'no_match') AS company_id,
    date(activity_date),
    MAX(comp.name) AS property_name,
    MAX(comp.property_tier) AS property_tier,
    MAX(comp.property_origin) AS property_origin,
    MAX(comp.property_status) AS property_status,
    COUNT(IF(activity_type = 'Call', 1, NULL)) AS calls,
    COUNT(IF(activity_type = 'Meeting', 1, NULL)) AS meetings,
    COUNT(IF(activity_type NOT IN ('Call', 'Meeting'), 1, NULL)) AS other_engagement,
    COUNT(IF(outcome = 'Complete', 1, NULL)) AS result_complete,
    COUNT(IF(outcome = 'Connected', 1, NULL)) AS result_connected,
    COUNT(IF(engagement_type = 'Blitz', 1, NULL)) AS activity_blitz,
    COUNT(IF(engagement_type = 'Lunch & Learn', 1, NULL)) AS activity_lunch_learn,
    COUNT(IF(engagement_type = 'Marketing', 1, NULL)) AS activity_marketing,
    IFNULL(comp.owner_id, 'no_owner') AS owner_id
    
    
    

from mdu_engagement
left join mdu_company comp
	on comp.hub_id = comp_hub_id
where activity_date between range_one and range_two
Group by comp.hub_id,date(activity_date);

end

procedures.name: initMra
procedures.contentString:
begin
drop table if exists addons_all;
create temporary table addons_all as 
select 
	db_id,
    account_number,
    order_number,
    mobile_number,
    order_id,
    carrier_system,
    addon,
    date_db_changed,
    '' as order_method
from raw_addon_frontier
union all
select 
	db_id,
    account_number,
    order_number,
    mobile_number,
    order_id,
    carrier_system,
    addon,
    date_db_changed,
    '' as order_method
from raw_addon_metronet
union all
select 
	db_id,
    account_number,
    order_number,
    mobile_number,
    order_id,
    carrier_system,
    addon,
    date_db_changed,
    'manual order' as order_method
from raw_addon_shell
union all
select 
	db_id,
    account_number,
    order_number,
    mobile_number,
    order_id,
    carrier_system,
    addon,
    date_db_changed,
    '' as order_method
from raw_addon_vexus
;




delete from orders.master_raw_addons;
insert into orders.master_raw_addons 
(
	db_id,
    account_number,
    order_number,
    mobile_number,
    order_id,
    carrier_system,
    addon,
    date_db_changed,
    mo_reconciliation_ref_id,
    mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2,
    mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3,
    mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4,
    mo_general_ref_id,
    order_method
)
select 
	db_id,
    account_number,
    order_number,
    mobile_number,
    order_id,
    carrier_system,
    addon,
    date_db_changed,
    
    case
		when i.carrier_system = 'dsi' then
			CONCAT(
				NULLIF(i.account_number, ''),
				coalesce(nullif(i.mobile_number,''),'0000000000'),
				'addon'
			)
		when carrier_system in('dtv','vexus') then
			CONCAT(
				NULLIF(i.account_number, ''),
				'addon'
			)
		  else
			CONCAT(
				NULLIF(i.order_number, ''),
				'addon'
			)
	end AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id,
	 
	 
	 
	  case
		when i.carrier_system = 'dsi' then
			CONCAT(
				NULLIF(i.account_number, ''),
				coalesce(nullif(i.mobile_number,''),'0000000000')
			)
		when carrier_system in('dtv','vexus') then

			NULLIF(i.account_number, '')
		  else
			NULLIF(i.order_number, '')


	end AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2,
	 
	 
	 
	  case
		when carrier_system in('dtv','dsi','vexus') then
			NULLIF(i.order_number, '')
		  else
			NULLIF(i.account_number, '')
	end AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3,
	 
	 
	 
	  'customer_name' AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4,
	 
	 
	 
	  case
		when i.carrier_system = 'dsi' then
			CONCAT(
				NULLIF(i.account_number, ''),
				coalesce(nullif(i.mobile_number,''),'0000000000')
			)
		when carrier_system in('dtv','vexus') then

			NULLIF(i.account_number, '')
		  else
			NULLIF(i.order_number, '')
	end AS mo_general_ref_id,
    i.order_method
from addons_all i;
end

                            mo_reconciliation_ref_id,
                            mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2,
                            mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3,
                            mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4,
                            mo_general_ref_id,
                            carrier_system,
                            date_db_insert
                        )
                        SELECT
                            r.db_id,
                            SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.agent_user_id, 'ftr', -1),
                            r.agent_user_id,
                            r.order_received_date,
                            r.quote_number,
                            r.frontier_order_number,
                            r.quote_number,
                            '0000000000' AS mobile_number,
                            CONCAT(r.customer_first_name, ' ', r.customer_last_name) AS customer_name,
                            r.btn AS customer_contact_number,
                            r.service_address AS customer_address_1,
                            '' AS customer_address_2,
                            r.service_city,
                            r.service_state,
                            REGEXP_SUBSTR(r.service_zip, '[0-9]{5}') AS zip_5,
                            s.translated_status AS status,
                            r.last_modified_date,
                            r.order_due_date,
                            'NEW' AS purchase_type,
                            IFNULL(NULLIF(r.data, ''), 'Default Frontier') AS package_name,
                            '' AS order_method,
                            MAX(pc.db_id) AS prodclass_ref_id,
                            MAX(e.db_id) AS empalign_ref_id,
                            MAX(m.db_id) AS markalign_ref_id,
                            MAX(rgn.db_id) AS regalign_ref_id,
                            MAX(d.db_id) AS divalign_ref_id,
                            CONCAT(
                                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(r.frontier_order_number, '')),
                                NULLIF(pc.product_type, '')
                            ) AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id,
                            COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(r.frontier_order_number, '')) AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2,
                            COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(r.quote_number, '')) AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3,
                            NULLIF(CONCAT(r.customer_first_name, ' ', r.customer_last_name), '') AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4,
                            COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(r.frontier_order_number, '')) AS mo_general_ref_id,
                            'frontier' AS carrier_system,
                            date_db_changed
                        FROM
                            orders.raw_frontier r
                        LEFT JOIN commissions.overwrite_values ov
                            ON ov.mo_db_id = r.db_id
                        LEFT JOIN airtable.align_employee_alignment e
                            ON SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.agent_user_id, 'ftr', -1) = e.employee_id
                            AND r.order_received_date BETWEEN e.start_date AND DATE_ADD(e.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                        LEFT JOIN airtable.align_market_alignment m
                            ON m.dept_code = e.dept_code
                            AND r.order_received_date BETWEEN m.start_date AND DATE_ADD(m.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                        LEFT JOIN airtable.align_region_alignment rgn
                            ON rgn.region_code = m.assigned_to_region_code
                            AND r.order_received_date BETWEEN rgn.start_date AND DATE_ADD(rgn.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                        LEFT JOIN airtable.align_division_alignment d
                            ON d.division_code = rgn.assigned_to_division_code
                            AND r.order_received_date BETWEEN d.start_date AND DATE_ADD(d.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                        LEFT JOIN airtable.align_unit_weights uw
                            ON m.primary_carrier = uw.carrier AND m.channel = uw.channel
                        LEFT JOIN airtable.align_product_classification_current pc
                            ON uw.program_id = pc.program_id
                            AND IFNULL(NULLIF(r.data, ''), 'Default Frontier') = pc.package_name
                            AND 'frontier' = pc.system_type
                            AND pc.purchase_type = 'NEW'
                        LEFT JOIN airtable.align_system_status s
                            ON r.order_status = s.system_status
                        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM master_raw_orders mro WHERE mro.carrier_system = 'frontier' and mro.db_id = r.db_id 
)
GROUP BY  r.db_id

    
;

INSERT INTO master_raw_orders (
                        db_id,
                        employee_id,
                        ref_login_username_id,
                        order_date,
                        order_id,
                        order_number,
                        account_number,
                        mobile_number,
                        customer_name,
                        customer_contact_number,
                        customer_address_1,
                        customer_address_2,
                        city,
                        state,
                        zip_5,
                        status,
                        status_change_date,
                        due_date,
                        purchase_type,
                        package_name,
                        order_method,
                        prodclass_ref_id,
                        empalign_ref_id,
                        markalign_ref_id,
                        regalign_ref_id,
                        divalign_ref_id,
                        mo_reconciliation_ref_id,
                        mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2,
                        mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3,
                        mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4,
                        mo_general_ref_id,
                        carrier_system,
                        date_db_insert
                    )
                    SELECT
                        r.db_id,
                        l.employee_id_checked,
                        r.sales_person_username,
                        r.create_time,
                        r.asap_order_id,
                        r.order_number,
                        r.account_number,
                        '0000000000' AS mobile_number,
                        r.customer_name,
                        r.wtn AS customer_contact_number,
                        r.street_address AS customer_address_1,
                        r.unit AS customer_address_2,
                        r.city,
                        r.state,
                        REGEXP_SUBSTR(r.zip_code, '[0-9]{5}') AS zip_5,
                        s.translated_status AS status,
                        r.status_change_date,
                        r.due_date,
                        'NEW' AS purchase_type,
                        IFNULL(NULLIF(r.internet_product_name, ''), 'Default ASAP') AS package_name,
                        r.order_type,
                        MAX(pc.db_id) AS prodclass_ref_id,
                        MAX(e.db_id) AS empalign_ref_id,
                        MAX(m.db_id) AS markalign_ref_id,
                        MAX(rgn.db_id) AS regalign_ref_id,
                        MAX(d.db_id) AS divalign_ref_id,
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(r.order_number, '')),
                            NULLIF(pc.product_type, '')
                        ) AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id,
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(r.order_number, '')) AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2,
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(r.account_number, '')) AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3,
                        NULLIF(r.customer_name, '') AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4,
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(r.order_number, '')) AS mo_general_ref_id,
                        'asap' AS carrier_system,
                        latest_insert_date
                    FROM raw_asap r
                    LEFT JOIN commissions.overwrite_values ov
                        ON ov.mo_db_id = r.db_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT
                            l.*,
                            CASE WHEN l.employee_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE l.employee_id END AS employee_id_checked,
                            e.start_date,
                            e.check_date
                        FROM airtable.align_logins l
                        JOIN airtable.align_employee_alignment e
                            ON l.employee_id = e.employee_id
                        WHERE l.system_column = 'ASAP'
                    ) l
                        ON r.sales_person_username = l.username
                        AND r.create_time BETWEEN l.start_date AND DATE_ADD(l.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_employee_alignment e
                        ON l.employee_id = e.employee_id
                        AND r.create_time BETWEEN e.start_date AND DATE_ADD(e.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_market_alignment m
                        ON m.dept_code = e.dept_code
                        AND r.create_time BETWEEN m.start_date AND DATE_ADD(m.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_region_alignment rgn
                        ON rgn.region_code = m.assigned_to_region_code
                        AND r.create_time BETWEEN rgn.start_date AND DATE_ADD(rgn.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_division_alignment d
                        ON d.division_code = rgn.assigned_to_division_code
                        AND r.create_time BETWEEN d.start_date AND DATE_ADD(d.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_unit_weights uw
                        ON m.primary_carrier = uw.carrier AND m.channel = uw.channel
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_product_classification_current pc
                        ON uw.program_id = pc.program_id
                        AND IFNULL(NULLIF(r.internet_product_name, ''), 'Default ASAP') = pc.package_name
                        AND pc.purchase_type = 'new'
                        AND 'asap' = pc.system_type
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_system_status s
                        ON r.order_status = s.system_status
                   where r.db_id not in (select mro.db_id from master_raw_orders mro where mro.carrier_system ='asap')
					GROUP BY r.db_id
                    ;
END

procedures.name: syncHubMo
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    START TRANSACTION;

    -- 1. Update fun_hub_queue with data from master_raw_orders
    UPDATE fun_hub_queue fhq
    JOIN master_raw_orders mro
      ON (
        (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility') AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           IF(fhq.mobile_number IS NULL OR fhq.mobile_number = '', '0000000000', fhq.mobile_number),
           NULLIF(fhq.product_type, '')
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id
        )
        OR
        (NOT (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility')) AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           NULLIF(fhq.product_type, '')
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id
        )
        OR
        (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility') AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           IF(fhq.mobile_number IS NULL OR fhq.mobile_number = '', '0000000000', fhq.mobile_number)
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2
        )
        OR
        (NOT (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility')) AND
         NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, '') = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2
        )
      )
    SET
      fhq.sync_status = 'Matching'
    WHERE fhq.sync_status = 'Pending';

    -- 2. Update master_raw_orders with data from fun_hub_queue
    UPDATE master_raw_orders mro
    JOIN fun_hub_queue fhq
      ON (
        (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility') AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           IF(fhq.mobile_number IS NULL OR fhq.mobile_number = '', '0000000000', fhq.mobile_number),
           NULLIF(fhq.product_type, '')
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id
        )
        OR
        (NOT (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility')) AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           NULLIF(fhq.product_type, '')
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id
        )
        OR
        (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility') AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           IF(fhq.mobile_number IS NULL OR fhq.mobile_number = '', '0000000000', fhq.mobile_number)
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2
        )
        OR
        (NOT (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility')) AND
         NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, '') = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2
        )
      )
    SET
      mro.employee_id = fhq.employee_id,
      mro.hub_fun_id = fhq.fun_id
    WHERE fhq.sync_status = 'Matching';

    -- 3. Mark matched rows as complete
    UPDATE fun_hub_queue
    SET sync_status = 'Matched'
    WHERE sync_status = 'Matching';

    COMMIT;
END

procedures.name: updateAirtableRefIds
updateReconciliationIdsByTable
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    SET @sql = CONCAT(
        'UPDATE ', table_name, ' mp ',
        'LEFT JOIN commissions.overwrite_values ov ON mp.db_id = ov.', id_name, ' ',
        'LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_logins l ',
        '   ON l.username = mp.ref_login_username_id ',
        '   AND l.system_column = mp.carrier_system ',
        'LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history sh ',
        '   ON sh.employee_id = COALESCE(l.employee_id, mp.employee_id) ',
        '   AND mp.order_date BETWEEN sh.start_date AND sh.end_date ',
        'LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team t ',
        '   ON sh.team_id = t.team_id ',
        'LEFT JOIN airtable.align_product_classification_current pc ',
        '   ON (CASE WHEN t.business_unit = 'd2d' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) = pc.program_id ',
        '   AND mp.package_name = pc.package_name ',
        '   AND (CASE ',
        '           WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv','dsi') THEN 'saraplus' ',
        '           WHEN mp.carrier_system LIKE 'lumos' THEN 'POPS' ',
        '           ELSE mp.carrier_system ',
        '       END) = pc.system_type ',
        '   AND pc.purchase_type = (CASE ',
        '           WHEN mp.purchase_type IS NULL OR mp.purchase_type = '' THEN 'NEW' ',
        '           ELSE UPPER(mp.purchase_type) ',
        '       END) ',
        'SET ',
        '   mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id = CASE ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')), ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, '0000000000'), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, '0000000000')), ',
        '           NULLIF(mp.product_type, '') ',
        '       ) ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN CONCAT(',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')), ',
        '           NULLIF(mp.product_type, '') ',
        '       ) ',
        '       ELSE CONCAT(',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')), ',
        '           NULLIF(mp.product_type, '') ',
        '       ) ',
        '   END, ',
        '   mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 = CASE ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')), ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, '0000000000'), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, '0000000000')) ',
        '       ) ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')) ',
        '       ELSE ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')) ',
        '   END, ',
        '   mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 = CASE ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')) ',
        '       ELSE ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')) ',
        '   END, ',
        '   mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 = NULLIF(mp.customer_name, ''), ',
        '   mp.mo_general_ref_id = CASE ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')) ',
        '       ELSE ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')) ',
        '   END ',
        'WHERE ',
        '   mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id IS NULL ',
        '   OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 IS NULL ',
        '   OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 IS NULL ',
        '   OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 IS NULL ',
        '   OR mp.mo_general_ref_id IS NULL'
    );

    PREPARE stmt FROM @sql;
    EXECUTE stmt;
    DEALLOCATE PREPARE stmt;
END

procedures.name: updateReconciliationIdsMa
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    UPDATE master_raw_addons mp
    LEFT JOIN commissions.overwrite_values ov
        ON mp.db_id = ov.ma_db_id
    
    SET
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, '')),
                'addon'
            )
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                'addon'
            )
            ELSE CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')),
                'addon'
            )
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, ''))
            )
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
        END,
        -- mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 = NULLIF(mp.customer_name, ''),
        mp.mo_general_ref_id = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
        END
    WHERE mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 IS NULL
       -- OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_general_ref_id IS NULL;
END

procedures.name: updateReconciliationIdsMro
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    UPDATE master_raw_orders mp
    LEFT JOIN commissions.overwrite_values ov
        ON mp.db_id = ov.mo_db_id 
LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_logins l
	on l.username = mp.ref_login_username_id and 
    l.system_column = mp.carrier_system
        
    LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history sh
		on sh.employee_id = coalesce(l.employee_id,mp.employee_id)
		and mp.order_date between sh.start_date and sh.end_date
	LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team t
		on sh.team_id = t.team_id
	LEFT JOIN airtable.align_product_classification_current pc
		ON case when t.business_unit = 'd2d' then 1 else 2 end = pc.program_id
		AND mp.package_name = pc.package_name
		AND case when mp.carrier_system in ('dtv','dsi') then 'saraplus' when mp.carrier_system like 'lumos' then 'POPS' else mp.carrier_system end = pc.system_type
		AND pc.purchase_type = CASE
			WHEN mp.purchase_type IS NULL OR mp.purchase_type  = '' THEN 'NEW'
			ELSE UPPER(mp.purchase_type) 
		end
    SET
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, '')),
                NULLIF(pc.product_type, '')
            )
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                NULLIF(pc.product_type, '')
            )
            ELSE CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')),
                NULLIF(pc.product_type, '')
            )
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, ''))
            )
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 = NULLIF(mp.customer_name, ''),
        mp.mo_general_ref_id = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
        END
    WHERE 
    
		mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_general_ref_id IS NULL
       and mp.status != 'abandoned'
       and pc.package_name is not null
       ;
END

procedures.name: alignMaRefIds
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    -- -----------------------------
    -- Update master_raw_orders table
    -- -----------------------------
    UPDATE master_activity ma
    JOIN (
        WITH RECURSIVE upline_ma AS (
            SELECT
                a.m_id as db_id,
                a.activity_date,
                e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id,
                t.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id,
                t.team_id_upline,
                e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id_level,
                t.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id_level,
                l.team_level
            FROM master_activity a
            LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e 
                ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id 
               AND a.activity_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
                   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
            LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
                ON t.team_id = e.team_id 
               AND a.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
                   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
            LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l
                ON l.team_id = t.team_id
            WHERE a.db_change_date > date_sub(now(),INTERval 2 day) and
				(a.upline_ref_id IS NULL
               OR a.seller_ref_id IS NULL
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_1 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_1 IS NOT NULL)
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_2 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_2 IS NOT NULL)

            LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e

        FROM upline_ma ro
        GROUP BY ro.db_id
    ) agg
    ON ma.m_id = agg.db_id
    SET 
        ma.seller_ref_id = agg.seller_ref_id,
        ma.upline_ref_id = agg.upline_ref_id,
        ma.seller_ref_id_level_1 = agg.seller_ref_id_level_6,

END

procedures.name: GenerateActivityPropertyDay
procedures.contentString:
begin
delete from reports.ag_mdu_activity_property_day where activity_date between range_one and range_two;

insert into reports.ag_mdu_activity_property_day(
	company_id,activity_date,
    property_name,
    property_tier,
    property_origin,
    property_status,
    calls,
    meetings,
    other_engagement,
    result_complete,
    result_connected,
    activity_blitz,
    activity_lunch_learn,
    activity_marketing,
    owner_id
    )
    
	
	
SELECT 
    IFNULL(comp.hub_id, 'no_match') AS company_id,
    date(activity_date),
    MAX(comp.name) AS property_name,
    MAX(comp.property_tier) AS property_tier,
    MAX(comp.property_origin) AS property_origin,
    MAX(comp.property_status) AS property_status,
    COUNT(IF(activity_type = 'Call', 1, NULL)) AS calls,
    COUNT(IF(activity_type = 'Meeting', 1, NULL)) AS meetings,
    COUNT(IF(activity_type NOT IN ('Call', 'Meeting'), 1, NULL)) AS other_engagement,
    COUNT(IF(outcome = 'Complete', 1, NULL)) AS result_complete,
    COUNT(IF(outcome = 'Connected', 1, NULL)) AS result_connected,
    COUNT(IF(engagement_type = 'Blitz', 1, NULL)) AS activity_blitz,
    COUNT(IF(engagement_type = 'Lunch & Learn', 1, NULL)) AS activity_lunch_learn,
    COUNT(IF(engagement_type = 'Marketing', 1, NULL)) AS activity_marketing,
    IFNULL(comp.owner_id, 'no_owner') AS owner_id
    
    
    

from mdu_engagement
left join mdu_company comp
	on comp.hub_id = comp_hub_id
where activity_date between range_one and range_two
Group by comp.hub_id,date(activity_date);

end

procedures.name: initMra
procedures.contentString:
begin
drop table if exists addons_all;
create temporary table addons_all as 
select 
	db_id,
    account_number,
    order_number,
    mobile_number,
    order_id,
    carrier_system,
    addon,
    date_db_changed,
    '' as order_method
from raw_addon_frontier
union all
select 
	db_id,
    account_number,
    order_number,
    mobile_number,
    order_id,
    carrier_system,
    addon,
    date_db_changed,
    '' as order_method
from raw_addon_metronet
union all
select 
	db_id,
    account_number,
    order_number,
    mobile_number,
    order_id,
    carrier_system,
    addon,
    date_db_changed,
    'manual order' as order_method
from raw_addon_shell
union all
select 
	db_id,
    account_number,
    order_number,
    mobile_number,
    order_id,
    carrier_system,
    addon,
    date_db_changed,
    '' as order_method
from raw_addon_vexus
;




delete from orders.master_raw_addons;
insert into orders.master_raw_addons 
(
	db_id,
    account_number,
    order_number,
    mobile_number,
    order_id,
    carrier_system,
    addon,
    date_db_changed,
    mo_reconciliation_ref_id,
    mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2,
    mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3,
    mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4,
    mo_general_ref_id,
    order_method
)
select 
	db_id,
    account_number,
    order_number,
    mobile_number,
    order_id,
    carrier_system,
    addon,
    date_db_changed,
    
    case
		when i.carrier_system = 'dsi' then
			CONCAT(
				NULLIF(i.account_number, ''),
				coalesce(nullif(i.mobile_number,''),'0000000000'),
				'addon'
			)
		when carrier_system in('dtv','vexus') then
			CONCAT(
				NULLIF(i.account_number, ''),
				'addon'
			)
		  else
			CONCAT(
				NULLIF(i.order_number, ''),
				'addon'
			)
	end AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id,
	 
	 
	 
	  case
		when i.carrier_system = 'dsi' then
			CONCAT(
				NULLIF(i.account_number, ''),
				coalesce(nullif(i.mobile_number,''),'0000000000')
			)
		when carrier_system in('dtv','vexus') then

			NULLIF(i.account_number, '')
		  else
			NULLIF(i.order_number, '')


	end AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2,
	 
	 
	 
	  case
		when carrier_system in('dtv','dsi','vexus') then
			NULLIF(i.order_number, '')
		  else
			NULLIF(i.account_number, '')
	end AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3,
	 
	 
	 
	  'customer_name' AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4,
	 
	 
	 
	  case
		when i.carrier_system = 'dsi' then
			CONCAT(
				NULLIF(i.account_number, ''),
				coalesce(nullif(i.mobile_number,''),'0000000000')
			)
		when carrier_system in('dtv','vexus') then

			NULLIF(i.account_number, '')
		  else
			NULLIF(i.order_number, '')
	end AS mo_general_ref_id,
    i.order_method
from addons_all i;
end

procedures.name: initMro
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    SET SESSION sql_mode = (SELECT REPLACE(@@SESSION.sql_mode, 'ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY', ''));

	delete from master_raw_orders;

	
	INSERT INTO master_raw_orders (
			db_id,
			employee_id,
			ref_login_username_id,
			order_date,
			order_id,
			order_number,
			account_number,
			mobile_number,
			customer_name,
			customer_contact_number,
			customer_address_1,
			customer_address_2,
			city,
			state,
			zip_5,
			status,
			status_change_date,
			due_date,
			purchase_type,
			package_name,
			order_method,
			prodclass_ref_id,
			empalign_ref_id,
			markalign_ref_id,
			regalign_ref_id,
			divalign_ref_id,
			mo_reconciliation_ref_id,
			mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2,
			mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3,
			mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4,
			mo_general_ref_id,
			carrier_system,
			date_db_insert
		)
		SELECT
			r.db_id,
			l.employee_id_checked,
			r.sales_person_username,
			r.create_time,
			r.asap_order_id,
			r.order_number,
			r.account_number,
			'0000000000' AS mobile_number,
			r.customer_name,
			r.wtn AS customer_contact_number,
			r.street_address AS customer_address_1,
			r.unit AS customer_address_2,
			r.city,
			r.state,
			REGEXP_SUBSTR(r.zip_code, '[0-9]{5}') AS zip_5,
			s.translated_status AS status,
			r.status_change_date,
			r.due_date,
			'NEW' AS purchase_type,
			IFNULL(NULLIF(r.internet_product_name, ''), 'Default ASAP') AS package_name,
			r.order_type,
			MAX(pc.db_id) AS prodclass_ref_id,
			MAX(e.db_id) AS empalign_ref_id,
			MAX(m.db_id) AS markalign_ref_id,
			MAX(rgn.db_id) AS regalign_ref_id,
			MAX(d.db_id) AS divalign_ref_id,
			CONCAT(
				COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(r.order_number, '')),
				NULLIF(pc.product_type, '')
			) AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id,
			COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(r.order_number, '')) AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2,
			COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(r.account_number, '')) AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3,
			NULLIF(r.customer_name, '') AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4,
			COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(r.order_number, '')) AS mo_general_ref_id,
			'asap' AS carrier_system,
			latest_insert_date
		FROM raw_asap r
		LEFT JOIN commissions.overwrite_values ov
			ON ov.mo_db_id = r.db_id
		LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT
				l.*,
				CASE WHEN l.employee_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE l.employee_id END AS employee_id_checked,
				e.start_date,
				e.check_date
			FROM airtable.align_logins l
			JOIN airtable.align_employee_alignment e
				ON l.employee_id = e.employee_id
			WHERE l.system_column = 'ASAP'
		) l
			ON r.sales_person_username = l.username
			AND r.create_time BETWEEN l.start_date AND DATE_ADD(l.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
		LEFT JOIN airtable.align_employee_alignment e
			ON l.employee_id = e.employee_id
			AND r.create_time BETWEEN e.start_date AND DATE_ADD(e.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
		LEFT JOIN airtable.align_market_alignment m
			ON m.dept_code = e.dept_code
			AND r.create_time BETWEEN m.start_date AND DATE_ADD(m.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
		LEFT JOIN airtable.align_region_alignment rgn
			ON rgn.region_code = m.assigned_to_region_code
			AND r.create_time BETWEEN rgn.start_date AND DATE_ADD(rgn.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
		LEFT JOIN airtable.align_division_alignment d
			ON d.division_code = rgn.assigned_to_division_code
			AND r.create_time BETWEEN d.start_date AND DATE_ADD(d.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
		LEFT JOIN airtable.align_unit_weights uw
			ON m.primary_carrier = uw.carrier AND m.channel = uw.channel
		LEFT JOIN airtable.align_product_classification_current pc
			ON uw.program_id = pc.program_id
			AND IFNULL(NULLIF(r.internet_product_name, ''), 'Default ASAP') = pc.package_name
			AND pc.purchase_type = 'new'
			AND 'asap' = pc.system_type
		LEFT JOIN airtable.align_system_status s
			ON r.order_status = s.system_status
	   where r.db_id not in (select mro.db_id from master_raw_orders mro where mro.carrier_system ='asap')
		GROUP BY r.db_id
		;
INSERT INTO master_raw_orders (
	db_id,
    employee_id,
    ref_login_username_id,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    order_number,
    account_number,
    mobile_number,
    customer_name,
    customer_contact_number,
    customer_address_1,
    customer_address_2,
    city,
    state,
    zip_5,
    status,

	   LEFT JOIN

		   AND r.order_date_internet BETWEEN e.start_date AND DATE_ADD(e.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
	   LEFT JOIN

		   AND r.order_date_internet BETWEEN m.start_date AND DATE_ADD(m.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
	   LEFT JOIN

		   AND r.order_date_internet BETWEEN rgn.start_date AND DATE_ADD(rgn.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
	   LEFT JOIN
		   airtable.align_division_alignment d ON d.division_code = rgn.assigned_to_division_code
		   AND r.order_date_internet BETWEEN d.start_date AND DATE_ADD(d.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
	   LEFT JOIN
		   airtable.align_unit_weights uw ON m.primary_carrier = uw.carrier AND m.channel = uw.channel
	   LEFT JOIN

	   LEFT JOIN

;

INSERT INTO master_raw_orders (
                        db_id,
                        employee_id,
                        ref_login_username_id,
                        order_date,
                        order_id,
                        order_number,
                        account_number,
                        mobile_number,
                        customer_name,
                        customer_contact_number,
                        customer_address_1,
                        customer_address_2,
                        city,
                        state,
                        zip_5,
                        status,
                        status_change_date,
                        due_date,
                        purchase_type,
                        package_name,
                        order_method,
                        prodclass_ref_id,
                        empalign_ref_id,
                        markalign_ref_id,
                        regalign_ref_id,
                        divalign_ref_id,
                        mo_reconciliation_ref_id,
                        mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2,
                        mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3,
                        mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4,
                        mo_general_ref_id,
                        carrier_system,
                        date_db_insert
                    )
                    SELECT
                        r.db_id,
                        l.employee_id_checked,
                        r.sales_person_username,
                        r.create_time,
                        r.asap_order_id,
                        r.order_number,
                        r.account_number,
                        '0000000000' AS mobile_number,
                        r.customer_name,
                        r.wtn AS customer_contact_number,
                        r.street_address AS customer_address_1,
                        r.unit AS customer_address_2,
                        r.city,
                        r.state,
                        REGEXP_SUBSTR(r.zip_code, '[0-9]{5}') AS zip_5,
                        s.translated_status AS status,
                        r.status_change_date,
                        r.due_date,
                        'NEW' AS purchase_type,
                        IFNULL(NULLIF(r.internet_product_name, ''), 'Default ASAP') AS package_name,
                        r.order_type,
                        MAX(pc.db_id) AS prodclass_ref_id,
                        MAX(e.db_id) AS empalign_ref_id,
                        MAX(m.db_id) AS markalign_ref_id,
                        MAX(rgn.db_id) AS regalign_ref_id,
                        MAX(d.db_id) AS divalign_ref_id,
                        CONCAT(
                            COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(r.order_number, '')),
                            NULLIF(pc.product_type, '')
                        ) AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id,
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(r.order_number, '')) AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2,
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(r.account_number, '')) AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3,
                        NULLIF(r.customer_name, '') AS mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4,
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(r.order_number, '')) AS mo_general_ref_id,
                        'asap' AS carrier_system,
                        latest_insert_date
                    FROM raw_asap r
                    LEFT JOIN commissions.overwrite_values ov
                        ON ov.mo_db_id = r.db_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT
                            l.*,
                            CASE WHEN l.employee_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE l.employee_id END AS employee_id_checked,
                            e.start_date,
                            e.check_date
                        FROM airtable.align_logins l
                        JOIN airtable.align_employee_alignment e
                            ON l.employee_id = e.employee_id
                        WHERE l.system_column = 'ASAP'
                    ) l
                        ON r.sales_person_username = l.username
                        AND r.create_time BETWEEN l.start_date AND DATE_ADD(l.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_employee_alignment e
                        ON l.employee_id = e.employee_id
                        AND r.create_time BETWEEN e.start_date AND DATE_ADD(e.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_market_alignment m
                        ON m.dept_code = e.dept_code
                        AND r.create_time BETWEEN m.start_date AND DATE_ADD(m.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_region_alignment rgn
                        ON rgn.region_code = m.assigned_to_region_code
                        AND r.create_time BETWEEN rgn.start_date AND DATE_ADD(rgn.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_division_alignment d
                        ON d.division_code = rgn.assigned_to_division_code
                        AND r.create_time BETWEEN d.start_date AND DATE_ADD(d.check_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_unit_weights uw
                        ON m.primary_carrier = uw.carrier AND m.channel = uw.channel
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_product_classification_current pc
                        ON uw.program_id = pc.program_id
                        AND IFNULL(NULLIF(r.internet_product_name, ''), 'Default ASAP') = pc.package_name
                        AND pc.purchase_type = 'new'
                        AND 'asap' = pc.system_type
                    LEFT JOIN airtable.align_system_status s
                        ON r.order_status = s.system_status
                   where r.db_id not in (select mro.db_id from master_raw_orders mro where mro.carrier_system ='asap')
					GROUP BY r.db_id
                    ;
END

procedures.name: syncHubMo
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    START TRANSACTION;

    -- 1. Update fun_hub_queue with data from master_raw_orders
    UPDATE fun_hub_queue fhq
    JOIN master_raw_orders mro
      ON (
        (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility') AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           IF(fhq.mobile_number IS NULL OR fhq.mobile_number = '', '0000000000', fhq.mobile_number),
           NULLIF(fhq.product_type, '')
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id
        )
        OR
        (NOT (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility')) AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           NULLIF(fhq.product_type, '')
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id
        )
        OR
        (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility') AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           IF(fhq.mobile_number IS NULL OR fhq.mobile_number = '', '0000000000', fhq.mobile_number)
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2
        )
        OR
        (NOT (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility')) AND
         NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, '') = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2
        )
      )
    SET
      fhq.sync_status = 'Matching'
    WHERE fhq.sync_status = 'Pending';

    -- 2. Update master_raw_orders with data from fun_hub_queue
    UPDATE master_raw_orders mro
    JOIN fun_hub_queue fhq
      ON (
        (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility') AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           IF(fhq.mobile_number IS NULL OR fhq.mobile_number = '', '0000000000', fhq.mobile_number),
           NULLIF(fhq.product_type, '')
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id
        )
        OR
        (NOT (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility')) AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           NULLIF(fhq.product_type, '')
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id
        )
        OR
        (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility') AND
         CONCAT(
           NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, ''),
           IF(fhq.mobile_number IS NULL OR fhq.mobile_number = '', '0000000000', fhq.mobile_number)
         ) = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2
        )
        OR
        (NOT (fhq.carrier_system = 'sara plus' AND fhq.product_type IN ('internet', 'mobility')) AND
         NULLIF(fhq.mo_ref_id, '') = mro.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2
        )
      )
    SET
      mro.employee_id = fhq.employee_id,
      mro.hub_fun_id = fhq.fun_id
    WHERE fhq.sync_status = 'Matching';

    -- 3. Mark matched rows as complete
    UPDATE fun_hub_queue
    SET sync_status = 'Matched'
    WHERE sync_status = 'Matching';

    COMMIT;
END

BEGIN

        'LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team t ',
        '   ON sh.team_id = t.team_id ',

        '       ) ',

        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')), ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, '0000000000'), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, '0000000000')) ',
        '       ) ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')) ',
        '       ELSE ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')) ',
        '   END, ',
        '   mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 = CASE ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')) ',
        '       ELSE ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')) ',
        '   END, ',
        '   mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 = NULLIF(mp.customer_name, ''), ',
        '   mp.mo_general_ref_id = CASE ',
        '       WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')) ',
        '       ELSE ',
        '           COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')) ',
        '   END ',
        'WHERE ',
        '   mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id IS NULL ',
        '   OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 IS NULL ',
        '   OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 IS NULL ',
        '   OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 IS NULL ',
        '   OR mp.mo_general_ref_id IS NULL'
    );

    PREPARE stmt FROM @sql;
    EXECUTE stmt;
    DEALLOCATE PREPARE stmt;
END

BEGIN

                'addon'
            )
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, ''))
            )
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
        END,
        -- mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 = NULLIF(mp.customer_name, ''),
        mp.mo_general_ref_id = CASE

            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))

    WHERE mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 IS NULL
       -- OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 IS NULL

procedures.name: updateReconciliationIdsMro

BEGIN

    LEFT JOIN commissions.overwrite_values ov
        ON mp.db_id = ov.mo_db_id 
LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_logins l
	on l.username = mp.ref_login_username_id and 
    l.system_column = mp.carrier_system
        
    LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history sh
		on sh.employee_id = coalesce(l.employee_id,mp.employee_id)
		and mp.order_date between sh.start_date and sh.end_date
	LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team t
		on sh.team_id = t.team_id
	LEFT JOIN airtable.align_product_classification_current pc
		ON case when t.business_unit = 'd2d' then 1 else 2 end = pc.program_id
		AND mp.package_name = pc.package_name
		AND case when mp.carrier_system in ('dtv','dsi') then 'saraplus' when mp.carrier_system like 'lumos' then 'POPS' else mp.carrier_system end = pc.system_type
		AND pc.purchase_type = CASE
			WHEN mp.purchase_type IS NULL OR mp.purchase_type  = '' THEN 'NEW'
			ELSE UPPER(mp.purchase_type) 
		end
    SET
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, '')),
                NULLIF(pc.product_type, '')
            )
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                NULLIF(pc.product_type, '')
            )
            ELSE CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, '')),
                NULLIF(pc.product_type, '')
            )
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility') THEN CONCAT(
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, '')),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.mobile_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.mobile_number, ''))
            )
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
        END,
        mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 = NULLIF(mp.customer_name, ''),
        mp.mo_general_ref_id = CASE
            WHEN mp.carrier_system IN ('dsi', 'sp internet', 'sp mobility', 'dtv', 'sp video', 'vexus') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.account_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.account_number, ''))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(ov.order_number, ''), NULLIF(mp.order_number, ''))
        END
    WHERE 
    
		mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_2 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_3 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_reconciliation_ref_id_4 IS NULL
       OR mp.mo_general_ref_id IS NULL
       and mp.status != 'abandoned'
       and pc.package_name is not null
       ;
END

procedures.name: alignMaRefIds
procedures.contentString:
BEGIN
    -- -----------------------------
    -- Update master_raw_orders table
    -- -----------------------------
    UPDATE master_activity ma
    JOIN (
        WITH RECURSIVE upline_ma AS (
            SELECT
                a.m_id as db_id,
                a.activity_date,
                e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id,
                t.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id,
                t.team_id_upline,
                e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id_level,
                t.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id_level,
                l.team_level
            FROM master_activity a
            LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e 
                ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id 
               AND a.activity_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
                   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
            LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
                ON t.team_id = e.team_id 
               AND a.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
                   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
            LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l
                ON l.team_id = t.team_id
            WHERE a.db_change_date > date_sub(now(),INTERval 2 day) and
				(a.upline_ref_id IS NULL
               OR a.seller_ref_id IS NULL
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_1 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_1 IS NOT NULL)
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_2 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_2 IS NOT NULL)
               OR (a.seller_ref_id_level_3 IS NULL AND a.upline_ref_id_level_3 IS NOT NULL)
               )

            UNION ALL

            SELECT 
                child.db_id,
                child.activity_date,
                child.seller_history_ref_id,
                child.upline_history_ref_id,
                t.team_id_upline,
                e.db_id AS seller_history_ref_id_level,
                t.db_id AS upline_history_ref_id_level,
                l.team_level
            FROM upline_ma child
            JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_upline_history t 
                ON t.team_id = child.team_id_upline 
               AND child.activity_date BETWEEN t.start_date 
                   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(t.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
            LEFT JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_seller_history e
                ON e.employee_id = t.team_id_owner
               AND child.activity_date BETWEEN e.start_date 
                   AND IFNULL(DATE_ADD(e.end_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2050-01-01')
            JOIN employee_alignment.align_emp_team l 
                ON l.team_id = child.team_id_upline
        )
        SELECT 
            ro.db_id,
            MAX(ro.seller_history_ref_id) AS seller_ref_id,
            MAX(ro.upline_history_ref_id) AS upline_ref_id,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 6 THEN ro.seller_history_ref_id_level END) AS seller_ref_id_level_6,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 6 THEN ro.upline_history_ref_id_level END) AS upline_ref_id_level_6,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 5 THEN ro.seller_history_ref_id_level END) AS seller_ref_id_level_5,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 5 THEN ro.upline_history_ref_id_level END) AS upline_ref_id_level_5,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 4 THEN ro.seller_history_ref_id_level END) AS seller_ref_id_level_4,
            MAX(CASE WHEN ro.team_level = 4 THEN ro.upline_history_ref_id_level END) AS upline_ref_id_level_4
        FROM upline_ma ro
        GROUP BY ro.db_id
    ) agg
    ON ma.m_id = agg.db_id
    SET 
        ma.seller_ref_id = agg.seller_ref_id,
        ma.upline_ref_id = agg.upline_ref_id,
        ma.seller_ref_id_level_1 = agg.seller_ref_id_level_6,
        ma.upline_ref_id_level_1 = agg.upline_ref_id_level_6,
        ma.seller_ref_id_level_2 = agg.seller_ref_id_level_5,
        ma.upline_ref_id_level_2 = agg.upline_ref_id_level_5,
        ma.seller_ref_id_level_3 = agg.seller_ref_id_level_4,
        ma.upline_ref_id_level_3 = agg.upline_ref_id_level_4
;

    
END

procedures.name: alignMoInsertRefIds

BEGIN
